about: NativePHP Mobile plugins the firstlight-init skill may propose for a new or existing Firstlight app, and plugins it must not propose because Firstlight already covers them. Facts come from each plugin's nativephp.json, its README and its NativePHP marketplace page on the checked date. Never add package versions, Composer constraints or prices: Composer picks versions when it installs, and the skill reads current prices from the marketplace.
disclaimer: Community plugins are listed for convenience. Neither Firstlight nor NativePHP maintains or warrants them. Check each plugin's licence and repository before you ship it.

plugins.name: App Guard
plugins.purpose: An app lock: hides the app in the app switcher, covers it when it returns after a timeout, keeps protected screens closed until unlocked, and copies secrets to a clipboard that clears itself.
use_cases: health, finance, journal or password records
hide the app in the app switcher

ios.does: Blurs the app in the app switcher and covers every window before the first frame on return after the timeout.

android.does: Sets FLAG_SECURE, so the app shows blank in the app switcher and blocks screenshots and screen recording, and covers the window before the first frame on return after the timeout.

pairs_with.nativephp/mobile-biometrics: the Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint prompt on the lock screen
pairs_with.nativephp/mobile-secure-storage: the optional PIN, which App Guard stores as a hash in secure storage

plugins.name: App Shortcuts
plugins.purpose: Opens a screen or runs a PHP action from Siri, Spotlight, the Shortcuts app and the app icon on iOS, and from launcher shortcuts on Android.

ios.does: Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts app actions and app-icon quick actions.

android.does: Launcher shortcuts on the app icon.

plugins.name: Local OCR
plugins.purpose: Scans multi-page documents with the system scanner and reads their text on the phone, without sending images or text off the device.

ios.does: VisionKit document camera and Apple Vision text recognition. Capture needs a real device.

android.does: ML Kit Document Scanner and ML Kit Text Recognition (Latin script). Needs Google Play services.

plugins.name: Local AI
plugins.purpose: Generates text with the language model already on the phone. Prompts and output never leave the device.

ios.does: Apple Foundation Models. Generates only on iOS 26 or later with Apple Intelligence turned on.

android.does: Gemini Nano through the ML Kit GenAI Prompt API, on devices that support AICore.

plugins.name: Custom Tabs
plugins.purpose: Lets people choose and reorder the app's tabs within the tabs, locks and limits the app declares, with a More screen and a drag-and-drop editor.
use_cases: let users reorder or pick tabs

ios.does: The system tab bar, with an edit-mode SwiftUI list for the editor.

android.does: The Material 3 navigation bar or Firstlight's tab bar, with drag-handle rows for the editor.

plugins.name: Network
plugins.purpose: Reports whether the device is online. Firstlight's Connectivity and data freshness notices use it to show offline state and refresh on reconnect.
use_cases: show when data was last updated

ios.does: Network status and change events.

android.does: Network status and change events.

plugins.name: Share
plugins.purpose: Opens the system share sheet to send text, links or files from the app to other apps.
use_cases: send a link or file to someone

ios.does: The system share sheet.

android.does: The system share sheet.

plugins.name: Browser
plugins.purpose: Opens URLs in the system browser or an in-app browser, and runs OAuth sign-in through the system's authentication session.

ios.does: The system browser, an in-app browser, and OAuth sign-in.

android.does: The system browser, an in-app browser, and OAuth sign-in.

plugins.name: Microphone
plugins.purpose: Records audio, with pause and resume.

ios.does: Audio recording with pause and resume.

android.does: Audio recording with pause and resume.

plugins.name: OTA updates
plugins.purpose: Sends new PHP code, views and assets to installed apps without a store review. Native changes, such as plugins or permissions, still need a store build.
use_cases: fix bugs without a store review

ios.does: Downloads, verifies and applies Bifrost-signed updates on the next start.

android.does: Downloads, verifies and applies Bifrost-signed updates on the next start.

setup: A Bifrost project with OTA enabled, and store builds made by Bifrost. The plugin refuses updates Bifrost did not sign.

plugins.name: Biometrics
plugins.purpose: Shows the system Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint prompt.

ios.does: Face ID or Touch ID, falling back to the device passcode.

android.does: Fingerprint or face unlock with a Cancel button. There is no passcode fallback.

plugins.without: The Biometrics facade is part of nativephp/mobile, so screens and tests still work. Biometrics::prompt() returns false and the lock screen shows its failure message.

plugins.name: Secure Storage
plugins.purpose: Encrypted key-value storage for tokens, credentials and other secrets.

ios.does: The Keychain, readable only while the device is unlocked, on this device only.

android.does: EncryptedSharedPreferences backed by the Android Keystore.

plugins.without: App Guard's PIN can't be set up, and a locked app always goes to the lock screen.

plugins.name: Firebase push notifications
plugins.purpose: Push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging: device registration, permission, deep links from notifications, background data messages and server-side sending.

ios.does: APNs through FCM, with the system permission prompt.

android.does: FCM, with the system permission prompt on Android 13 and later.

setup: A Firebase project with the iOS and Android apps added.
google-services.json and GoogleService-Info.plist in the project root.
The Push Notifications capability in the Apple Developer account, and an APNs key uploaded to Firebase.
A Firebase service account key on the server that sends pushes.
plugins.without: No push notifications. The rest of the app works unchanged.

plugins.name: Actions Anywhere
plugins.purpose: Turns the app's actions into Siri phrases, Shortcuts-app actions and Spotlight results on iOS, and Quick Settings tiles and action links on Android, from one config file.
use_cases: log something without opening the app

ios.does: Siri phrases, Shortcuts-app actions and Spotlight results through App Intents.

android.does: Up to six Quick Settings tiles and action links. No voice assistant.

plugins.without: No Siri, Spotlight or Quick Settings entry points; people open the app to act.

plugins.name: Home Screen Shortcuts
plugins.purpose: Up to four long-press shortcuts on the app icon that open a route.

ios.does: App-icon quick actions. A shortcut tapped while the app is not running opens the app but not the route.

android.does: Launcher app shortcuts, on warm and cold start.

plugins.name: Share Sheet
plugins.purpose: Receives links, text, photos and files shared into the app from other apps.
use_cases: save links or photos from other apps

ios.does: A Share Extension in the system share sheet.

android.does: An entry in the system share menu for links, text, photos and files.

setup: A paid Apple Developer account, because the iOS Share Extension needs an App Group.
plugins.without: The app can't receive shared content; people add it inside the app instead.

plugins.name: Store Review
plugins.purpose: Asks for an App Store or Google Play rating with the system's in-app review prompt.

ios.does: SKStoreReviewController. iOS decides whether the prompt appears.

android.does: Play In-App Review. Google Play decides whether the prompt appears.

plugins.name: Animated splash screen
plugins.purpose: Animated splash screens with gradients, events and configuration.

ios.does: An animated splash after launch.

android.does: An animated splash after launch.

plugins.name: Enhanced splash
plugins.purpose: A jump-free Android system splash and vector splash images on iOS.

ios.does: Vector splash images.

android.does: The system splash without the jump to the app's own splash.

plugins.name: Charts
plugins.purpose: Line, area, bar, scatter, candlestick, radar, pie and doughnut charts as one <native:chart> element, drawn natively. Firstlight has no charts.

ios.does: SwiftUI Canvas. The author has not yet verified iOS on a device or simulator.

android.does: Jetpack Compose Canvas, verified by the author on a device.

covered_by_firstlight.covered_by: Media in image mode, which has its own camera and photo library pickers.
covered_by_firstlight.unless: the app records video or needs camera features beyond taking one photo

covered_by_firstlight.covered_by: Alert Dialog, Confirmation Dialog and Transient Feedback.
Firstlight Haptics, which plays the platform's own patterns.
covered_by_firstlight.unless: the app needs custom vibration patterns

covered_by_firstlight.covered_by: Media in document mode, which uses the system file picker.
covered_by_firstlight.unless: the app saves files out to a location the user picks
